text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is... Guess I've just gotta 
brace myself.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature-senpai! Whatcha doing in the 
Pre-Fi section?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Were you looking at the Pretty Fight 
costume? Could it be that you're going to 
wear it, Nature?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, it's not like that... Well, not 
entirely, but still! There's a whole story 
behind this—

text_block_list.name: Fruit Stand Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis Nature! Guess what? My birthday is 
this Sunday!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, congrats~! Well then, I'd better 
prepare a present for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You guys always give me extra fruit at the 
store, so if there's anything this big sis 
can do, I'll grant whatever wish you have~

text_block_list.name: Fruit Stand Girl
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Well, you see... I wanna meet 
Pretty Fight!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—But there's nowhere doing a Pretty Fight 
show right on the day of her birthday...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
After talking so big, I can't just go, 
"Oops, guess I couldn't do it~" ya know? I 
really want to give her a proper 
celebration, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Which means... as a last resort, maybe my 
only option is to become Pretty Fight 
myself... or something...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's awesome! She's definitely 
gonna love that!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wait, I just had a great idea! Why 
don't you two play Pretty Fight instead?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The costume sizes fit you perfectly, and 
you've got that sparkly, heroic Pretty 
Fight vibe going on! Right? I'll back you 
up from behind the scenes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Back us up...? Aren't you gonna be 
Pretty Fight, Nature-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no. I'm not sparkly like you two, 
and cute outfits totally aren't my thing—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pretty Fight just wouldn't suit me, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Nature-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she just couldn't be honest with 
herself, so her words and feelings ended 
up turning all topsy-turvy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Face her head-on. If you do, her true 
feelings will definitely shine through!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But you were planning on wearing it until 
just a moment ago, weren't you? You really 
wanna give her a proper celebration, don't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whether it suits you or not doesn't 
matter! What matters is heart! I can 
clearly see your sincere, caring heart, 
Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right! Let's deliver 
a marvelous present directly from you, 
Nature☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tell us how you really feel! We'll cheer 
you on with all our might!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Sigh... Honestly, why do every last one 
of you have to be such good kids?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A burning heart is the proof of justice! 
Princess Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Making the whole world even more 
marvelous☆ Princess Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll protect the peace of the shopping 
district! Pr-Princess Nature...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the park, Biko Pegasus 
and the others were playing Pretty Fight 
for some reason, fully geared up in 
costumes...

text_block_list.name: Fruit Stand Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~! Are you the real ones?! There's 
three Pretty Fights I've never seen 
before!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Your wish for peace summoned new Pretty 
Fights to your side! Come, let us save the 
world together!!

text_block_list.name: Fruit Stand Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis Nature, thank you so much for 
today! This is the best birthday ever!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you happy makes this big sis happy 
too. But... keep it a secret from everyone 
that we're Pretty Fight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh! She looked so super happy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... In the end, I'm glad I celebrated 
it myself. If I had run away and left it 
to someone else, I probably would've 
regretted it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thanks, guys. For giving me that push.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching them smile so brightly, I decided 
to keep today's scene locked in my heart, 
and quietly walked away.
